cards.back: The answer when a whole number is multiplied by itself. Example: 6 × 6 = 36, so 36 is a square number.
cards.say: What is a square number? The answer when a whole number is multiplied by itself. Example: six times six equals thirty six, so thirty six is a square number.
Three squared. Nine. Three squared means three times three.
Five squared. Twenty five
Seven squared. Forty nine
Eight squared. Sixty four
Nine squared. Eighty one
Eleven squared. One hundred and twenty one
Twelve squared. One hundred and forty four
Fifteen squared. Two hundred and twenty five. Fifteen times fifteen equals two hundred and twenty five.
Twenty squared. Four hundred. Twenty times twenty equals four hundred.

cards.back: The answer when a whole number is multiplied by itself, then by itself again. Example: 3 × 3 × 3 = 27.
cards.say: What is a cube number? The answer when a whole number is multiplied by itself, then by itself again. Example: three times three times three equals twenty seven.
Two cubed. Eight. Two cubed means two times two times two.
Three cubed. Twenty seven
Four cubed. Sixty four. Four times four times four equals sixty four.
Five cubed. One hundred and twenty five
Ten cubed. One thousand. Ten times ten times ten equals one thousand.

The square root asks: what number times itself makes 49? 7 × 7 = 49.
cards.say: Square root of forty nine. Seven. The square root asks: what number times itself makes forty nine? Seven times seven equals forty nine.
Square root of eighty one. Nine
Square root of one hundred and forty four. Twelve
Square root of one hundred. Ten
Which is bigger, four squared or two cubed? Four squared equals sixteen and two cubed equals eight, so four squared is bigger.

cards.back: No. 7² = 49 and 8² = 64, so 50 falls between two squares.
cards.say: Is fifty a square number? No. Seven squared equals forty nine and eight squared equals sixty four, so fifty falls between two squares.

cards.front: Find a number under 100 (not 1) that is both a square number and a cube number.
cards.say: Find a number under one hundred, not one, that is both a square number and a cube number. Sixty four, because eight squared equals sixty four and four cubed equals sixty four.

cards.back: 16, which is 4². Adding the first 4 odd numbers gives 4².
cards.say: What is one plus three plus five plus seven? Sixteen, which is four squared. Adding the first four odd numbers gives four squared.
